claim_limitations: Core only. Portable Restoration Continuity and every other optional profile are out of scope; restoration is used only as a harness path to reach Core behavior (PORT-RESTORE-001, PORT-PRESERVE-001 as applicable).
Observations of canonical effects use an administrative observer channel supplied by each adapter; caller-visible checks use only the raw runtime return value.

Concurrent invocation is NOT EXECUTABLE; single-lineage and conflict behavior is checked sequentially. This evidence does not establish the thread safety or concurrent behavior of the implementation under test; native tests remain complementary.
Native timestamp independence is NOT EXECUTABLE when the adapter exposes no clock hook for accepted history.
Timing and other side channels are outside AUTH-DISCLOSE-001 and are not measured.
